recovery: Prior temporary raw artifacts and ledger are unavailable. Published summaries remain; exact old-artifact replay is impossible.
selection: Next unused task in long-feature-v1-selection.json frozen order
artifact: One engineer-only implementation, frozen once regardless of grade; exact same patch and base for both reviews. No repair or regeneration.
review_contract: Solo flow with native reviewer role, no manager inference, no delegation, report outside task repository; verify unchanged tree and role provenance.
blinding: Neither reviewer receives hidden tests, reference patch, verifier outcomes, engineer transcript, or the other review.
judgment: Verify findings against requirements and reproductions; separate supported defects, unsupported findings, and environment limits. A correct artifact may make this diagnostic uninformative.
storage: Durable ficus-evaluation-data directory; private tokens and raw logs excluded from Git
